Subject: KubeCon week — quick demo time options

Hi Joe,

Thanks again for taking time during KubeCon week. Nina mentioned Acme would like a short 30–40 minute product walkthrough focusing on routing and cost controls. We're flexible but want to lock a slot that works across time zones since I know some of your team will be remote.

A few proposals (all in local times with conversions below):
- Wed Oct 22, 10:00 AM CDT (Austin local) — that's 4:00 PM BST (London) and 1:00 AM HKT (Singapore)
- Wed Oct 22, 3:00 PM CDT — 9:00 PM BST & 6:00 AM HKT (next day)
- Thu Oct 23, 8:00 AM CDT — 2:00 PM BST & 11:00 PM HKT

If none work, tell me the best 2-hour window for your region and we can adjust — Rafael or Vivek can present depending on availability. I've attached the latest demo deck and a calendar .ics we can edit.

Note: I will be on-site at KubeCon (hotel is showing local time = Austin). People sometimes accidentally join on hotel-room time if they open invites there; if anyone is joining from home, they might see a different offset. We'll confirm the time zone in the calendar invite when we finalize.

Best,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sales Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183
Redwood Inference

Hi Marissa — thanks, that helps.

Quick context: I'm based in London (BST) but will be in Austin Thu–Sat for KubeCon. Nina and a couple folks will join remotely from Bangalore (IST) and Tokyo (JST). We ran into DST shifts last year where calendar invites showed local hotel time and people missed the call, so appreciate the explicit conversions.

Of your slots, the Wed Oct 22 3:00 PM CDT option is closest for most of us (9:00 PM BST / 6:30 AM IST next day / 10:00 PM JST). It's late for some, but manageable. Could we aim for 40 minutes and ask you to start with a 10-min overview and spend 20 on the routing demo? Also please confirm the timezone encoded into the .ics — some clients (Outlook mobile) pick up the hotel device timezone.

If Rafael is presenting, great — otherwise Vivek's deep-dive on batching would be perfect.

Joe
Joe Santos
Platform PM, Acme Corp

Subject: Confirmed: Wed Oct 22 3:00 PM CDT / 9:00 PM BST — Redwood demo (40 min)

Hi Joe, Nina — locking Wed Oct 22, 3:00 PM CDT for 40 minutes.

Authoritative time: America/Chicago (CDT). Calendar invite attached (meeting-invite-ics-20251022.ics) — please check the time shown on your device and the invite description where I've added conversions for common zones. Quick conversion table for convenience:
- 3:00 PM CDT (America/Chicago) = 9:00 PM BST (London)
- 3:00 PM CDT = 6:30 PM IST (Bangalore) 
- 3:00 PM CDT = 10:00 PM JST (Tokyo)

Agenda (40 min):
1) 10 min — Intro + high-level routing/cost controls (Marissa)
2) 20 min — Live demo: batching / fallback policies (Rafael)
3) 7 min — Q&A / next steps

Attachments included: redwood-demo-deck-v3.pdf, pre-read-routing-1pager.pdf, meeting-invite-ics-20251022.ics. Rafael, Vivek — thanks for covering the technical portion.

Note on hotel/local device clocks: If anybody joins from a hotel room, please double-check the invite time — some hotel devices default to local wall time even if your phone is still set to home zone. If there's any doubt, join via the Zoom link in the invite and the host will admit at the scheduled America/Chicago time.

See you then,
Marissa
